paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: : Modality Distribution

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of various audio content categories, with a total of seven slices. The largest slice, labeled "Speech," is a dark purple and constitutes approximately 29.4% of the chart. The "Mix-Sound-Speech" slice follows, colored in a light purple, representing 21.8%. Next is "Music," depicted in medium purple, occupying 20.6% of the chart. The "Sound" category, also light purple, spans 16.5%. A darker purple segment labeled "Mix-Music-Speech" accounts for 8.2%. The slices labeled "Mix-Sound-Music-Speech" and "Mix-Sound-Music," both in purple, represent 2.4% and 1.1% respectively. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices and employs variations of purple to distinguish between categories. The slices appear to be ordered primarily by size but are not visually emphasized through explosion or offset techniques.
